Should your soap go through gel phase? 🤔

Gel phase is when fresh soap heats up and turns see-through for a while. Both ways make good soap.

✅ Gelled soap often has brighter colours
✅ To avoid gel, soap cooler or put the mould somewhere cool
✅ Partial gel can leave a dark ring. It's cosmetic only
